notes.title: Update from July 15th
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where the character would not turn if you assigned movement keys on the keyboard other than "WASD" or "Arrows".

[*] Fixed a bug with incorrect display of "Japanese" and "Chinese" characters.

[*] Increased the power and damage range of the "Thunder Spray" spell.

[*] Added buttons to reduce the "Ability bar".
[/olist]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed a bug where the character would not turn if you assigned movement keys on the keyboard other than "WASD" or "Arrows".
[*] Fixed a bug with incorrect display of "Japanese" and "Chinese" characters.

tags.balance_change: [*] Increased the power and damage range of the "Thunder Spray" spell.

tags.feature: [*] Added buttons to reduce the "Ability bar".
